# Daily Briefing – Thursday 16 July

Yesterday was a mixed bag. No training session logged and just 7,364 steps, but your body was still burning 2,391 kcal — slightly above your 2,300 target, which is a small win for the deficit. The big concern is sleep: 4.7 hours simply isn't enough recovery, full stop.

The good news is your HRV at 111ms sits comfortably within your 101–119ms baseline, and a resting HR of 47bpm with stress at just 28/100 suggests your body handled the short night better than expected. You're recovered enough to train today — go as planned, but listen carefully if fatigue creeps in.

That sleep debt is your priority tonight — aim for 8 hours. Poor sleep suppresses muscle protein synthesis, so hit your 175g protein target today regardless, and consider front-loading it earlier in the day to maximise recovery heading into tomorrow.
